A beautiful and delicious experience in Hoi An
Apr 2026 • Friends
Our experience at Le Petit Bistro was wonderful, start to finish. We were greeted with a warm welcome and seated at a table in the courtyard. The servers were friendly, organized, and attentive. We started with wine and the charcuterie and cheese board, yum. All of our entrees were beautifully presented and perfectly seasoned. The confit duck, mushroom risotto, mahi mahi, and chicken breast exceeded all of our expectations. None of us had room for dessert but I’m sure they are delicious! 
A shout out to our hostess, she is a delight and knows how to create a memorable dining experience.
